trivia-chessboard: Can also be used as a checkerboard.
trivia-chesspiece-king: The most important piece; protect it at all costs.
trivia-chesspiece-knight: Has unique movement in an 'L' shape.
trivia-chesspiece-pawn: The pawns are the soul of chess.
trivia-chesspiece-queen: The most powerful piece, combining rook and bishop movements.
trivia-chesspiece-rook: Moves in straight lines horizontally or vertically.
trivia-checkerpiece: Can be flipped to switch between pawn and king.
trivia-goboard-9x9: Ideal for beginners to learn Go.
trivia-goboard-17x17: Historically used before the 19x19 board became the standard.
trivia-goboard-19x19: The standard board for playing Go.
trivia-morrisboard-three: A simplified version of Morris, great for quick games.
trivia-morrisboard-six: Can also used for five men's morris.
trivia-morrisboard-nine: The classic Nine Men's Morris game.
trivia-morrisboard-twelve: Can also used for eleven men's morris.
trivia-shogipiece: Used to play shogi, also known as Japanese chess.
trivia-shogiboard: Used as the board for shogi, also known as Japanese chess.
